assets.name: EggWakeAtlas
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create production artwork for the special egg-hatching ritual in Dotlings, a tender premium virtual-pet app. Reference image is STYLE ONLY: soft tactile toy-like 3D rendering, lilac/cream palette. Do not include the pet. Make a 1536x1024 transparent PNG sprite atlas, exactly THREE columns by TWO rows of 512x512 cells. Each cell contains the SAME beautiful pearlescent egg, a softly rounded asymmetric egg silhouette, ivory ceramic shell with a fine velvety bloom, restrained lavender iridescence, three tiny embedded pale-gold flecks, no face, no symbols, no ornament around it. Egg body about 238px wide and 310px tall per cell, base at y=408 and horizontal center x=256 in EVERY cell. Large clear margins, identical size, camera and silhouette. Reading left to right: 1 sleeping egg with soft opal sheen; 2 a very faint warm amber light inside the lower shell; 3 awake, warm golden light visible through thin translucent porcelain, still intact; 4 same awake egg leaning an almost imperceptible ONE degree left, base unchanged; 5 same awake egg leaning ONE degree right, base unchanged; 6 upright again, small hairline crack on upper third carrying a thread of champagne gold light. The cracked shell must remain fully closed. Gentle sculptural studio lighting, polished high-end animated-film quality. Quiet, precious, emotionally magical. GENUINELY transparent background, no ground plane, no backdrop, no text, no labels, no panel borders, no stars, no hearts, no glitter particles, no creature. Never clip any egg at the cell edges. This is one coherent fixed-camera sequence, not six different eggs.

assets.name: EggOpenAtlas
assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset: second six-frame sprite atlas of the SAME Dotlings egg shown in the reference. Exact same pearl-lilac ivory softly velvet ceramic egg, iridescence, three gold flecks, camera, lighting, body size and base alignment. Transparent 1536x1024 PNG, exactly THREE columns by TWO rows, each cell 512x512, no separators. Continue the hatching sequence, left to right across rows: 1 SAME closed egg with the fine upper crack extended halfway down carrying warm champagne light; 2 SAME closed egg with several thin connected glowing cracks, still holding together; 3 SAME closed egg as the cracks gently open a few millimeters, a soft warm inner glow visible, no flash; 4 upper shell cap gently lifting just 25 pixels above lower shell, bright soft warm light inside; 5 shell opens into two broad curved halves moving slightly to either side, open center full of soft warm light; 6 final empty opened shell, two pearl-lilac curved shell pieces resting low at bottom corners, and a very soft warm glow between them. The final cell has a TRANSPARENT EMPTY CENTER above the low shell pieces: the app will place its chosen pet there. No pet in any frame. Keep maximum composition INSIDE each 512 cell with at least 45px transparent margin all sides. Egg before opening should have the same apparent size in frames 1-3; base stays at same vertical coordinate through every frame. Gentle intimate magical reveal, precious and tactile, premium 3D animation stills. No face, no text, no labels, no stars, no hearts, no confetti, no sparks, no flying debris, no background, no floor. True alpha transparency. Preserve exact reference identity, this is a continuation of that egg.
